usageNotes: Use this to inspect the current status of all replication jobs running on a specific node, including last sync time, next scheduled run, and any error states. The target node must be online and reachable within the cluster; calling against an offline node will fail. Requires VM.Audit on each VM whose replication jobs you want to see — jobs for VMs the caller cannot audit are omitted from results.

examples.summary: List all replication jobs on node pve1, filtered to VM 105

tips: Omit the 'guest' filter to see every replication job on the node at once — useful for a quick cluster health check.
Each returned object includes an 'id' in the form '<vmid>-<jobnum>' (e.g. '105-0'); use that id to drill into per-job details via the child endpoint.
A job with 'fail_count' > 0 and a non-null 'error' field indicates the last sync failed — check the node's replication log for details.
Replication only applies to VMs and containers configured with at least one replication target; VMs without replication jobs will not appear in the response.
